Using h+ℓ=w and h−ℓ=1/w, the normalized midpoint area equals (u+v)(1/u+1/v)/4, giving δ=(u−v)²/(4uv)=ε⁴/(uv)>0.

Uniformly on [v,u], −L′=ε+O(ε²), giving Δ=2ε³+O(ε⁴); 2t₀Δ contributes 4ε³/3 and the CDF excess contributes 8ε³/9. Thus S=4ε³/9+O(ε⁴). For α>3/4 the exact inequality S/δ^α>ε^(3−4α)/4 diverges along rational ε, covering every finite real C. There is no endpoint claim at α=3/4.
